newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Grange shares gain ground on results.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Grange shares gain ground on results.

text.p: Shares in mineral explorer, Grange Resources NL jumped 30 percent to an intraday high of 16.9 cents in active trade on Tuesday after the company reported encouraging results from the Mt Windsor joint venture in Queensland, brokers said.

Grange said the joint venture manager, RGC Ltd, had reported high grade intersections of copper mineralisation with the most significant being 53.5 metres at 16.4 percent copper and 0.6 grammes per tonne (g/t) gold from 102 metres.
"There had been plenty of excitement in the stock," said a Perth broker, adding that the results were the cause of the surge in interest for the stock.
"The results certainly sounded impressive in terms of the intersection and the grade." he said.
Grange shares closed 2.5 cents higher at 15.5 cents on heavy turnover of 11.3 million shares.
